items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 26 at 9:07PM EST until November 27 at 10:00AM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, 1 to 2 feet of
inundation above ground level in low-lying areas near
shorelines and tidal waterways. For the High Surf Advisory,
large breaking waves of 5 to 8 feet in the surf zone.

* WHERE...West Carteret and Coastal Onslow Counties.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 10 AM EST Friday.
For the High Surf Advisory, until 8 PM EST this evening.

* IMPACTS...1 to 2 feet of inundation above ground level is
possible in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways resulting in a low threat of property damage. Some
roads and low lying property including parking lots, parks,
lawns, and homes adjacent to the waterfront will experience
shallow flooding. Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions
and localized beach erosion.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 26 at 3:17PM EST until November 27 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and
seas 7 to 12 ft.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Ocracoke Inlet to Surf City.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
